verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.36
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 6.36

verses.pali: 4. Devatāvagga
verses.english: 4. Deities

verses.pali: Vivādamūlasutta
verses.english: Roots of Dispute

verses.pali: “Chayimāni, bhikkhave, vivādamūlāni.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these six roots of dispute.

verses.pali: Katamāni cha?
verses.english: What six?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kodhano hoti upanāhī.
verses.english: Firstly, a mendicant is irritable and acrimonious.

verses.pali: Yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kodhano hoti upanāhī so sattharipi agāravo viharati appatisso, dhammepi agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghepi agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāyapi na paripūrakārī hoti.
verses.english: Such a mendicant lacks respect and reverence for the Teacher, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and they don’t fulfill the training.

verses.pali: Yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī so saṅghe vivādaṁ janeti, yo hoti vivādo bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṁ.
verses.english: They create a dispute in the Saṅgha, which is for the detriment and suffering of the people, against the people, for the harm, detriment, and suffering of gods and humans.

verses.pali: Evarūpañce tumhe, bhikkhave, vivādamūlaṁ ajjhattaṁ vā bahiddhā vā samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, bhikkhave, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānāya vāyameyyātha.
verses.english: If you see such a root of dispute in yourselves or others, you should try to give up this bad thing.

verses.pali: Evarūpañce tumhe, bhikkhave, vivādamūlaṁ ajjhattaṁ vā bahiddhā vā na samanupasseyyātha, tatra tumhe, bhikkhave, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṁ anavassavāya paṭipajjeyyātha.
verses.english: If you don’t see it, you should practice so that it doesn’t come up in the future.

verses.pali: Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānaṁ hoti. Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṁ anavassavo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how to give up this bad root of dispute, so it doesn’t come up in the future.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu makkhī hoti paḷāsī …pe…
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant is offensive and contemptuous …

verses.pali: issukī hoti maccharī …
verses.english: They’re jealous and stingy …

verses.pali: saṭho hoti māyāvī …
verses.english: devious and deceitful …

verses.pali: pāpiccho hoti micchādiṭṭhi …
verses.english: with corrupt wishes and wrong view …

verses.pali: sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī.
verses.english: They’re attached to their own views, holding them tight, and refusing to let go.

verses.pali: Yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī, so sattharipi agāravo viharati appatisso, dhammepi agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghepi agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāyapi na paripūrakārī hoti.
verses.english: Such a mendicant lacks respect and reverence for the Teacher, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and they don’t fulfill the training.

verses.pali: Yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme … saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṁ janeti, yo hoti vivādo bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṁ.
verses.english: They create a dispute in the Saṅgha, which is for the detriment and unhappiness of the people, against the people, for the harm, detriment, and suffering of gods and humans.

verses.pali: Evarūpañce tumhe, bhikkhave, vivādamūlaṁ ajjhattaṁ vā bahiddhā vā samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, bhikkhave, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānāya vāyameyyātha.
verses.english: If you see such a root of dispute in yourselves or others, you should try to give up this bad thing.

verses.pali: Evarūpañce tumhe, bhikkhave, vivādamūlaṁ ajjhattaṁ vā bahiddhā vā na samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, bhikkhave, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṁ anavassavāya paṭipajjeyyātha.
verses.english: If you don’t see it, you should practice so that it doesn’t come up in the future.

verses.pali: Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānaṁ hoti. Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṁ anavassavo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how to give up this bad root of dispute, so it doesn’t come up in the future.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cha vivādamūlānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the six roots of dispute.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
